artworks.title: The Little Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in a dimly lit interior setting. The scene is characterized by sketchy lines and darker shading in certain areas. The figures appear to be engaged in various activities, with one seemingly bent over a task in the foreground. The composition leads the eye around the picture, with the forms of the figures being defined through an interplay of light and shadow. The background features a textured treatment, suggesting a rustic or workshop-like environment. The lines are loose and flowing, giving the drawing an impressionistic feel, highlighting the movement and interactions within the space.

artworks.title: The Little Forge
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 22.6 × 15 cm (8 7/8 × 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene. The image shows a room with a complex arrangement of lines and figures. Various shapes and forms hint at objects and furniture in the foreground. The drawing conveys movement and depth through its use of cross-hatching and varied line density. It has a sketch-like quality, with an expressive nature, providing insight into the ambiance of the environment.

artworks.title: The Little Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures engaged in activity in a workshop or similar setting. The artwork includes a group of figures, a large wheel, and various objects creating an industrial or labor environment. The drawing uses hatching and cross-hatching techniques for texture and depth. Bold lines define the architecture and composition of the space. The figures have dynamic poses, suggesting movement and focus on their tasks, creating an industrious ambiance.

artworks.title: Two Ships
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two large sailboats docked on calm water, with tall masts and intricate rigging. In the background, similar ships and structures are visible, suggesting a busy port scene. The artist uses a delicate, linear style with fine etching strokes to depict details. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast of dark lines against a light background. The background features masts of other ships and vague outlines of the port, adding depth and perspective to the scene.

artworks.title: Steamboats off the Tower
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a serene harbor scene. In the foreground, two figures sit in a rowboat. In the background, there are tall masted ships lined up, and other boats and buildings hinted at in the distance. The etching uses fine, flowing lines to depict the reflections in the water and the forms of the ships. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on an off-white background, creating a light and airy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Steamboats off the Tower
artworks.description: This image depicts a harbor scene with ships docked in the background. The view is from a slightly elevated angle. The etching technique is used to create the image. The water reflects the ships and structures on the shoreline. A small boat with two figures can be seen nearby. The color palette is monochromatic, with soft brown and charcoal tones. The background shows silhouettes of buildings and masts against a light sky.

artworks.title: London Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows an arching bridge spanning horizontally. People are walking on the bridge with goods. In the background, there are buildings and docks. On the water, there is a rowboat and a larger vessel. The artwork uses fine lines with shading, creating forms. The color scheme is sepia and black.

artworks.title: Price's Candle-Works
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a low, water-level perspective. The horizon runs horizontally along the center, separating the water and sky. Industrial buildings with tall chimneys and a bridge are visible on the horizon. Near the viewer are two faintly sketched boats, one with rowing figures and another with a covered figure or cargo. The art style features light, sketchy, and loose etching lines, creating a simple and unfinished appearance. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of beige and black, typical of etching on paper.

artworks.title: Price's Candle-Works
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a riverscape. The horizon is in the center, with buildings and industrial structures like chimneys on the left and a bridge on the right. A sailboat with dark sails is in the middle, accompanied by faint lines indicating figures in a small boat. The lines are light and sparse, creating a sketch-like quality with more defined strokes around the sailboat and chimneys. The color palette is subdued, with natural tones and black lines for a tranquil and simple look.

artworks.title: Price's Candle-Works
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial and urban setting along a waterway. Various buildings, chimneys, and a distinctive arching bridge are visible. The sketch features minimal and linear brushstrokes outlining boats and buildings. The color palette is primarily sepia on a light beige surface. Boats with faintly indicated figures are close by, while industrial structures create a skyline in the distance. The background is a simple sky with sparse, sweeping lines to indicate clouds or movement.

artworks.title: Battersea Morn
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective from a shore looking across water towards a cityscape. The skyline of the city features pointed and dome-like structures. The sketch-like style uses sparse lines to create a sense of the city's silhouette with buildings, chimneys, and smokestacks. Boats are faintly visible on the water. The color palette is monochrome with a parchment background and dark pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Battersea: Dawn
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a cityscape across a body of water. Industrial structures, boats, and a pale sky are depicted with light pencil strokes on an off-white background. The color palette is soft beiges and light grays.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats, Hastings
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with boats and tall masts on a beach. Buildings and a hillside can be seen in the background. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, and there are figures and objects near the boats. The artist used a sketch-like technique with fine lines and cross-hatching to create depth, shadow, and texture in a monochromatic color scheme.

artworks.title: Wych Street
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural street view with a line of buildings leading towards a vanishing point. The horizon is implied, as the buildings recede along a narrowing street. Bold, angled lines depict texture and dimension on the building facades. The monochromatic palette uses sepia and warm tones. The buildings on the left are detailed, with visible windowpanes and shaded ledges, while those on the right and in the distance are less distinct. Faint outlines of distant architecture can be seen in the background, tapering off into a blurred point.

artworks.title: Wych Street
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with old buildings lining an alley or narrow street. The buildings have a rustic architectural style with detailed windows and textured roofs. The horizon is obscured by the buildings extending into the distance. The scene fades into less detail towards the right, suggesting further buildings and a distant street lamp. The color palette is primarily in sepia tones, emphasizing the linear detail and texture of the etching technique used.

artworks.title: Little Smithfield
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow alleyway with tall buildings in the background. The buildings fill up most of the frame, obscuring the horizon. The scene is depicted in a monochrome color palette of black and grey on sepia-toned paper. The fine, linear brushstrokes detail the textures of the buildings. Two figures are seated in the foreground, while in the distance, window grids and rooftops can be seen.

artworks.title: Temple Bar
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from a slightly elevated perspective, focusing on an ornate archway in the center. The horizon is blocked by buildings and the archway. The brushstrokes are sketchy and loose, with light lines outlining buildings, people, and horses. The color palette is muted, with sepia tones and grayish-black shadows. There are outlines of a horse and carriage in the foreground, while the background depicts blurred buildings, emphasizing the archway's details.

artworks.title: Free Trade Wharf
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dock or waterfront scene from a high viewpoint. The horizon is in the middle of the composition, where the sea meets buildings and ships. The detailed lines suggest an etching style, with cross-hatching creating depth. Masts of sailing ships are on the left, and warehouses are on the right. The color palette is monochromatic. In the foreground, there is a rowboat with a figure and another boat tied to the dock. The scene conveys a sense of trade or shipyard activity.

artworks.title: Lord Wolseley
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body profile facing left. He has short, neatly combed hair, a part along the top, lightly etched facial features, a pronounced nose, and is wearing a suit with a high-collared shirt. The background consists of hatched lines for depth, with shading and texture to define form and light.

artworks.title: The Thames Towards Erith
artworks.description: The image depicts a body of water with several boats, some rowboats with figures in the foreground. More boats and larger ships can be seen in the distance along with a structure on the far right. The sky above is rendered with diagonal strokes. The overall color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of pencil.

artworks.title: The Thames Towards Erith
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from a slightly elevated position overlooking a body of water. The horizon line is marked by ships and masts in the upper third of the composition. The sky above shows cloud-like forms. Small boats with figures on them are seen near the viewer. In the distance, there are sailing vessels on the water leading to larger, docked ships. On the right side, there is a structure by the water, possibly a boathouse. Linear strokes are used to depict texture and movement in the water and sky. The image is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow created by the pencil or etching technique.

artworks.title: Lindsey Houses
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with a small town and harbor viewed from across the water. The horizon is in the middle, partially hidden by buildings and sailboats. The sailboats have tall masts and angled sails. The brushstrokes are soft and sketch-like, suggesting motion in the water and texture in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and sepia. In the distance, there are scattered buildings and trees. The composition conveys a calm atmosphere at the waterfront.

artworks.title: From Pickle-Herring Stairs
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a wide body of water with a bustling harbor scene. Numerous sailing vessels with tall masts are visible on the horizon, alongside distant smokestacks releasing smoke into the sky. Closer to the viewer, smaller boats are faintly outlined with fine, diagonal strokes. The left side of the composition features a waterfront with buildings. The artwork is characterized by loose, sketch-like lines and varying densities of hatching to suggest depth and perspective. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of gray, giving it a muted visual impact.
